name: Climbazole
description: Climbazole (CAS 38083-17-9 ), also known by the trade names Baypival and Crinipan AD, is an imidazole-based antifungal active used across personal care, pharmaceutical, and industrial applications. It targets fungal growth, particularly Malassezia species, making it a standard active ingredient in anti-dandruff and scalp treatment formulations for various consumer products. In personal care, this compound is incorporated into shampoos, conditioners, and scalp serums at low concentrations to control dandruff-causing fungi and maintain healthy scalp conditions. Pharmaceutical formulators use it as an active or intermediate in topical antifungal preparations targeting dermatological conditions. It is highly effective in specialized medical skin care treatments. In textile and leather processing, it functions as a biocide to prevent mold and fungal degradation during storage and finishing. This ensures the longevity and quality of raw materials. Paper manufacturers apply it as a preservative treatment to protect against fungal spoilage in humid storage environments. This application is critical for maintaining structural integrity in industrial settings. The material is supplied as a white to off-white crystalline powder. Standard commercial grades include technical and cosmetic-grade material, with purity specifications typically at 98% or higher by HPLC. Packaging is available in kilogram quantities for formulators and larger bulk formats for industrial buyers. We ensure all batches meet rigorous internal quality control and safety protocols.
